rationale: Sources emit upward and rightward rays in their own colours; 8 stays unchanged. The two 4 sources in demonstration 1 produce overlap colour 6 to their right. Demonstration 3 preserves the 4 source while the 1 ray continues through it.

Colours 1, 2, 3 and 4 emit upward and rightward rays in their own colours. Demonstration 1 preserves the upper 3 source as the lower ray passes it, with overlap 6 above it. Demonstration 3 leaves 8 unchanged and marks both crossings on row 1 as 6.

Sources cast rightward and downward rays in their own colours, with overlaps coloured 6. Demonstration 2 paints over the 8 with 1, preserves source pixels, and produces 6 below the vertically aligned 2 and 1 sources.

Colours 1, 3 and 4 cast rays in all four diagonal directions using their source colours. Demonstration 2 marks the crossing at row 5, column 5 as 2. Demonstration 3 preserves both 8 cells, continues diagonals beyond occupied cells, and colours multiple ray intersections 2.
